verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules, such as auto-filing or auto-paying when a deadline arrives, are a fair question for a business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only manual filing: PDF forms submitted by upload, fax or mail, plus a CAPTCHA-gated annual-report portal. There is no documented way to define rules, triggers or automated actions, and probes found no API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
